blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—A total of 380 pairs, or 760 pickleball players, converged at the Thirsty Pickle at SM Seaside City Cebu complex for the inaugural Cebu City Pickleball Open 2026. The Cebu City Sports Commission (CCSC) organized the three-day tournament, which kicked off on Friday, November 20. CCSC Chairman Dr. Rhoel Dejano and Executive Director Rocky Alcoseba led the organizers, with the approval of Cebu City Mayor Nestor Archival. The tournament features six categories: advanced beginner, intermediate, advanced, open, 50-above, and 17-under, with men’s, women’s, and mixed doubles divisions.
